summary: This is round 3 of an explicit PROGRESS.md-reconstruction fix, and the PR's own title/commit history ("reconstruct PROGRESS.md correctly", "remove duplicate PROGRESS.md header line from reconstruction") claims the file is now properly reconstructed, but diffing this branch against the real current origin/main (tip 4edfc273) shows it still is not: the two content blocks this PR adds are misattributed to the wrong task sections. The new "## Remaining" items about a curl example/report-id/self-service API-key UI and STRICT_TENANT_ISOLATION are appended under task-20260727-182023's (Product chain-selector / PR #607) Remaining header even though that content plainly belongs to a different task (reporting-api-gateway--external-ai-scope), whose own header exists earlier in the file with an empty body. At the very end of the diff, "- [ ] None -- task complete" and "- [ ] Fresh supervisor audit of PR #607, then merge (not by this session)." are appended directly under the new task-20260727-153025 (re-audit OWNER_ENGINE) section's "## Completed" header with no "## Remaining" header separating them, and reference PR #607, which belongs to an unrelated task, not the re-audit task this section is documenting. The new ai-os/audits/owner_engine_reaudit_2026-07-27.md report and the ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml recently_completed entry are themselves well-sourced (real gh/bun test evidence, valid YAML) and not the problem; the defect is specifically in the PROGRESS.md reconstruction this PR exists to fix. No .github/workflows/** files are touched by this diff. Given the PR's sole stated purpose is a correct reconstruction and that goal is not actually met, this should not be merged as-is.
issues: PROGRESS.md: the added "## Remaining" items (curl/report-id example, self-service API-key UI note, STRICT_TENANT_ISOLATION) are attached to task-20260727-182023's (capability-tree-service Product-chain-selector, PR #607) Remaining header, but the content describes a different task (reporting-api-gateway--external-ai-scope) whose own header exists earlier in the file with no body -- misattributed audit-trail content.

PROGRESS.md: the final two added lines ("- [ ] None -- task complete" and "- [ ] Fresh supervisor audit of PR #607, then merge (not by this session).") are appended under the new task-20260727-153025 section's "## Completed" header with no "## Remaining" header, and reference PR #607, which is unrelated to this (re-audit) task -- orphaned/misattributed content, same defect class round 3 was supposed to have eliminated.

The PR's central claim (title and commit messages: PROGRESS.md 'properly reconstructed') is not borne out by the actual diff contents -- this round still leaves the audit trail internally inconsistent.
